pages.title: Black Smoker
pages.text: The mouth of a hydrothermal vent: water at 400 C pours out of it, black with metal sulfides that crystallise the moment it meets the cold sea. Its plume lifts and scalds whoever swims into it, and the grazers and crabs gather round. Found on the chimneys of the vent fields in Titan's hidden ocean.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Sulfuric Acid.
